name: @actualjob/mcp-server

tools.name: jd_cancel_analysis
tools.description: Stop an in-flight analysis. The analysis workflow polls for cancellation between steps and exits cooperatively. Partial blob fragments are cleaned up async by jd-ephemeral-cleanup.

tools.name: jd_connect_source
tools.description: Start an OAuth flow for a data source. Returns a URL the human must visit. v1: provider='google' (Calendar + Gmail). v1.1 adds provider='asana' and provider='hubspot'. Slack remains future work.

tools.name: jd_create_report_link
tools.description: Mint a short-lived (15 min) HMAC-signed URL that opens the generated JobDescription in the web viewer without exposing the caller's agent token. Use this to share a read-only preview with the subject or a teammate.

tools.name: jd_delete_analysis
tools.description: CCPA-compliant delete with verification pipeline. Requires an explicit confirmation phrase.

tools.name: jd_disconnect_source
tools.description: Revoke an OAuth connection at the provider and destroy the stored tokens. Fail-open on Google-side revoke: server-side cleanup always runs; google_revoked=false means Google still has a refresh token cached and the user should visit https://myaccount.google.com/permissions to fully revoke.

tools.name: jd_estimate_analysis
tools.description: Phase 1 of two-phase consent. Returns a detailed scope preview (source counts, estimated cost, PII redaction summary, retention timeline) plus a scope_preview_token (24h TTL, no time pressure).

tools.name: jd_export_description
tools.description: Export a generated job description to a portable format. v1 returns rendered Markdown inline in the response (no R2 + signed URL yet — that lands with the email-destination follow-up). PDF, Google Doc, and ATS JSON destinations are deferred to v1.1. Idempotency-Key protects against double-export on agent retry: same key + same params returns the cached export. Writes a visible_outputs audit row so the user sees what their agent did on their behalf.

tools.name: jd_generate_description
tools.description: Wizard tool — composes the 4-call analysis flow (jd_estimate_analysis → jd_validate_consent → jd_start_analysis → jd_get_analysis_status poll → jd_get_description) into a 2-call agent UX. Phase 1 (no confirmation_token in params): wraps jd_estimate_analysis and returns scope_preview + confirmation_token. Phase 2 (confirmation_token in params): wraps jd_validate_consent + jd_start_analysis and returns the analysis_id immediately. The caller polls jd_get_analysis_status separately. v1 does NOT long-poll inside the wizard (CF Workers I/O budget concern flagged in multipov; the spike to validate the long-poll path is deferred to a follow-up). Each composed call goes through its own gate stack — wizard is sugar, not bypass.

tools.name: jd_get_analysis_status
tools.description: Poll for analysis progress. Returns current status, progress_percent, cost so far, and (once complete) the description_blob_key. Safe to poll frequently — no audit row is written per call.

tools.name: jd_get_audit_log
tools.description: Privacy transparency — what tools were called, by whom, when. Every event has actor_type, agent_name (if any), legal_responsibility_chain.

tools.name: jd_get_consent_status
tools.description: Returns the user's consent records across the v1 consent surface: data_processing, analytics, team_analysis, multi_model_verification, visible_outputs.email. Synthesizes a `granted: false` row for any consent type the user has never touched, so callers always receive a complete shape.

tools.name: jd_get_description
tools.description: Fetch the generated job description as structured JSON. Only valid once jd_get_analysis_status reports status='complete'. Returns the DescriptionBlob from R2 verbatim — schema_version + description fields + evidence_refs + cost/latency.

tools.name: jd_get_split_status
tools.description: Read the current state of an entity-split correction by split_id. Useful for polling the workflow's progress after jd_split_entity returns. Returns 'pending' (queued), 'reindexing' (workflow running), 'complete' (ready — corrections_applied is now in jd_get_description), or 'failed' (with error_code). Multipov v1 jd_split_entity Medium revision: multiple reviewers asked for an explicit status surface so callers don't have to poll jd_get_description's corrections_applied array.

tools.name: jd_issue_agent_token
tools.description: Issue a new per-device agent token for the signed-in human. Returns the plaintext `agent_<id>_<secret>` EXACTLY ONCE — the caller MUST capture it immediately. Requires a human Supabase JWT; agent actors are rejected (human_actor_required). Rate limit: 5 / 60s per user. Per-user cap: 10 active (unrevoked) tokens — exceeding returns agent_token_cap_exceeded.

tools.name: jd_list_agent_tokens
tools.description: List the signed-in human's agent tokens (revoked ones included so the UI can show them greyed out). Requires a human Supabase JWT; agent actors rejected. No secrets returned — only the public `token_id`, name, device_label, and timestamps.

tools.name: jd_list_analyses
tools.description: List the authenticated user's past analyses. Cursor-paginated.

tools.name: jd_list_connections
tools.description: List the authenticated user's connected sources, with status.

tools.name: jd_list_sources
tools.description: Return the v1/v1.1 source catalog with role-fit hints for agent discoverability. Pure read, no auth required — this is static product copy, not user data. Replaces the deferred `signal_strength_per_source` field on jd_estimate_analysis (docs/plans/2026-04-19-asana-hubspot-design.md § 'Radical v1 descope' #4). Use this before `jd_connect_source` so the agent can pick the highest-signal source for the user's role.

tools.name: jd_prep_check
tools.description: Validate that the caller can successfully run an analysis right now (credentials valid, quotas healthy, no open deletion requests, rate limits headroom, data residency aligned). Best-practice hint, not a stateful gate.

tools.name: jd_refine_description
tools.description: Apply chat-based refinement to a generated job description. Every refinement preserves the evidence_refs audit chain.

tools.name: jd_report_pii_leak
tools.description: User-facing PII leak reporting. Opens a P0 incident wired to the Data Spillage Incident Runbook. Rate-limited to 10 reports per user per hour at the handler level (defense-in-depth, not gateway-only). The leaked text is stored in pii_incidents.quoted_text under RLS for the runbook investigation; the alert email links to the DB row and never quotes the leaked text directly.

tools.name: jd_request_data_export
tools.description: CCPA / US-privacy data portability — returns a machine-readable JSON bundle of every record we hold for the authenticated user (users row, connections summary with ciphertext redacted, analyses, generated DescriptionBlobs, audit_logs over the retention window, user_consents, exports, cost_events). v1 returns the bundle inline in the response (sync assembly). Async/email-delivered bundles via R2 + signed URL land with the CC2 framework follow-up. Skips the data_processing consent gate — CCPA right to portability is unconditional.

tools.name: jd_revoke_agent_token
tools.description: Revoke one of the signed-in human's agent tokens by its public `token_id`. Soft-delete (sets revoked_at = now()). Idempotent — revoking an already-revoked token returns revoked=false with no error. Requires a human Supabase JWT; agent actors rejected.

tools.name: jd_split_entity
tools.description: Correct a low-confidence entity merge by splitting it back into its component parts. Operates on entities flagged as ambiguous in jd_get_description's `low_confidence_entity_merges` array. v1 ships the metadata-only contract surface — the request is recorded as `status='pending'` and the affected DescriptionBlob sections are re-rendered when the reindex workflow lands in v1.0.1. Validation is strict: every email in the source entity must be assigned to exactly one of the new entities (no duplicates, no orphans, no inventing emails outside the source set).

tools.name: jd_start_analysis
tools.description: Kick off an analysis. Requires a fresh signed_consent_token from jd_validate_consent. Returns immediately; background work is queued and advanced by the ingest worker. Poll jd_get_analysis_status for progress.

tools.name: jd_update_consent
tools.description: Grant or revoke a specific consent type. Idempotent: a no-op grant returns success without rewriting timestamps. Revoking `data_processing` while an analysis is in flight returns 409 `data_processing_revoke_blocked` — the caller should cancel the analysis first.

tools.name: jd_validate_consent
tools.description: Phase 2 of two-phase consent. Ratifies a scope_preview_token from jd_estimate_analysis after the user has reviewed the scope. Returns a server-signed signed_consent_token (60-min TTL).
